title: DialogueTree
description: A Skyrelda dialogue tree. One file per conversation, served from /data/dialogue/<id>.json. The id field must match the filename without extension.

id.description: Unique identifier. Must match the filename without .json extension. Use kebab-case.

startNodeId.description: Key of the first node to display. Must exist in the nodes map.

nodes.description: All nodes in this tree, keyed by node ID (kebab-case string).

DialogueNode.description: A single beat of dialogue. Either presents choices for the player or auto-advances to the next node.

speaker.description: Display name shown in the nameplate. Use the NPC's in-world name, not their ID.

portrait.description: Key for the portrait sprite. Resolved via DialogueUI.registerPortrait(). Use kebab-case. Use 'none' for narration nodes with no portrait.

text.description: Dialogue text rendered by the TypeWriter. Supports line breaks via \n. Keep under ~200 characters per node for comfortable reading speed.

choices.description: Player response options. If omitted or empty, the node auto-advances using autoNextNodeId. Do not mix choices with autoNextNodeId — choices take precedence.

autoNextNodeId.description: Node to advance to automatically 600ms after typing completes, when no choices are present. null explicitly ends the conversation. Omit entirely for nodes that have choices.

setsFlag.description: World flag set immediately when this node is first displayed (before the player reads it). Use kebab-case. Fires before any choice side effects.

oneOf.description: Choice node — presents options to the player.
Auto-advance node — chains to the next node (or ends) without player input.
Dead-end node — no choices, no autoNextNodeId. Confirm press closes the conversation.

DialogueChoice.description: A single player response option. Side effects fire in order: setsFlag → startsQuest → completesQuest.

label.description: Display text shown in the choice list. Write in first person from the player's perspective. Keep under ~60 characters.

nextNodeId.description: Node to navigate to when this choice is selected. null ends the conversation immediately.

requiresFlag.description: This choice is hidden unless the named world flag is set. CURRENTLY STUBBED — all choices are always visible until WorldState (#16) is implemented. Use kebab-case.

setsFlag.description: World flag set when this choice is selected. Fires before startsQuest / completesQuest.

startsQuest.description: Quest ID to start when this choice is selected. Fires after setsFlag, before completesQuest. The quest system must have this ID registered.

completesQuest.description: Quest ID to complete when this choice is selected. Fires last. The quest must already be active.

greet.speaker: Guild Master
greet.text: Ah, a new face. Welcome to the Tinker's Guild.

about-guild.speaker: Guild Master
about-guild.text: We repair the old machines. The Workshop has been dark for years.

quests.speaker: Guild Master
quests.text: Clear the Forgotten Workshop and I'll see you're well rewarded.
